elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence
professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M where vendor processes Customer Data
elements.evidence: where HDI processes Confidential Information or user information of the Company, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law
provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request

elements.element: Obligation placed on Vendor (counterparty), at its own expense
elements.evidence: HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement
errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present at or above the required limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M conditioned on processing Company confidential/user information, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request), and the duty runs against the vendor HDI at its own expense.

The insertion is a concise new sub-section 10.9 for an otherwise absent insurance clause; the headings/counterparts language and all surrounding terms are untouched, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ('Confidential Information' and 'Company' are defined in the Agreement).

Minor note only: 'and for one (1) year thereafter' adds a short post-termination coverage tail slightly beyond the stated preferred position; it is customer-favourable, does not alter any other commercial term, and is noted in the rationale rather than treated as a deviation.
Fallback limits (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) are comfortably exceeded, so the clause would also clear the fallback bargain if the higher limits were negotiated down.
